'''2007 Texas State Championship Jim Sharp DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jim Sharp]] at [[2007 Texas State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Combat Readiness (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)|OVS8-30-Combat_Readiness-remaster.webp|label=Combat Readiness (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' I really suck
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
